tweet.text:
I keep seeing people post charts showing CCC spreads above 1,000 bps...as if that’s a sign that levered credit is finally cracking. 

I’m not denying the widening. Technically, it’s accurate. But I suspected a few capital structures (each with their own idiosyncratic issues) were behind a lot of the move. 

So I went through the index bond by bond to see if that was true. What I found was that about half of this year’s CCC widening came from just 5 capital structures.

Here's my full write-up:

https://www.junkbondinvestor.com/p/credit-weekly-the-ccc-myth
